conventions.name: max-module-length
conventions.description: Source modules stay at or under 300 lines so agents can read them whole.
conventions.hint: Split the module; providers/, model, render each own one concern.

conventions.name: max-test-module-length
conventions.description: Test modules stay at or under 400 lines.
conventions.hint: Split by command or provider under test.

conventions.name: source-is-documented
conventions.description: Every source module, public class, and public function has a docstring.
